about: Trick-or-treat hours for every La Porte County, IN community, read by laporteweathernow.com/trick-or-treat (the page updates within about 10 minutes of a change here; no site publish needed). Rules: put hours under 'hours' only when the town itself (its website, council, police or official social page) or reliable local news has announced them for this year, with that source and status 'official' (the town or its police) or 'reported' (local news). Until then hours stays null and 'last' shows last year's hours with their source. Never copy last year's hours into 'hours'. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD and times are 24-hour Central Time. 'events' are extra trick-or-treat events with their own date, hours and source; drop or correct one if its organizer changes it. 'fun' lists fall places (group 'farm': pumpkin patches, orchards, wagon rides, corn mazes; group 'haunt': haunted houses and rides) that are open this year. Add one only when its own website or official page (or the state or county tourism listing) shows this year's dates, and copy them into 'when' as plain words, with Eastern time marked for places in Michigan. 'until' (YYYY-MM-DD) is its last open day this season; the page hides it the day after. 'funChecked' is the day the list was last checked.

events.name: Downtown La Porte Trick or Treat
events.note: Put on by the Downtown La Porte Events committee. It's separate from the city-wide trick-or-treat on Oct. 31.

source.name: City of La Porte events calendar

events.name: Trick or Treat at the Scairport
events.place: La Porte Municipal Airport, 2341 State Road 39 S
events.note: Free, but families must register ahead (the form is on the airport's page).

events.name: Boo at the Zoo
events.place: Washington Park Zoo, 115 Lake Shore Dr., Michigan City
events.note: Last entry 3:30 p.m. Adults $12, ages 2 to 11 $10, under 1 free. Rain or shine.

events.name: Franciscan Health Trunk-or-Treat
events.place: Franciscan Health, 301 W. Homer St., Michigan City
events.note: Check-in starts at 4 p.m. Decorated cars, treats, food and drinks.

events.name: Trick-or-Treat on Franklin Street
events.place: Downtown Michigan City, starting at 7th and Franklin streets
events.note: Trick-or-treating is 3 to 5 p.m., with costume contests, live music and food trucks.

events.name: YMCA Trunk-or-Treat
events.place: Michigan City Elston YMCA parking lot
events.note: Free and open to everyone. Costumes encouraged.

events.name: Museum Trick or Treat
events.place: La Porte County Historical Society Museum, 2405 Indiana Ave., La Porte
events.note: Free. Trick-or-treat with "time-traveling ghosts" on the main floor. A quieter session, 1 to 1:45 p.m., is for kids with disabilities or anyone who'd like a calmer visit.

events.name: Trick or Treat in Pioneerland
events.place: La Porte County Fairgrounds, 2581 W. State Road 2, La Porte
events.note: Trick-or-treat through the fairgrounds' historic Pioneer Land village. It's part of the fairgrounds' Halloween Happenings weekend, Oct. 23 to 25.

events.name: La Porte Police Trunk or Treat
events.place: La Porte Civic Auditorium, 1001 Ridge St., La Porte
events.note: The police department's third annual trunk-or-treat.

events.name: Orak Shrine Trunk-or-Treat
events.place: Orak Shrine Center, 3848 N. Frontage Rd., Michigan City

events.name: Wolfie's Night Out Trick or Treat
events.place: Ames Field, 2501 Franklin St., Michigan City
events.note: Free, for Michigan City Area Schools students and their families.

events.name: Halloween Fun Fair
events.place: Michigan City H.O.P.E. Community Center, 222 McClelland Ave.
events.note: Free; sign up on Eventbrite (the city's page links it). Games, a talent show and karaoke.

fun.name: Garwood Orchard & Farm Market
fun.when: U-pick daily through Oct. 31, 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. The last wagon to the fields leaves at 4:45 p.m.
fun.note: No charge for parking or the wagon ride; you pay for what you pick ($20 minimum per family). The farm says to call first, (219) 362-4385, since weather can change its hours. The market stays open through Thanksgiving.

fun.name: Pumpkin Festival Weekends at Johnson's Farm
fun.when: Saturday and Sunday, Oct. 24 and 25, and Saturday, Oct. 31, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. (last admission 5 p.m.)
fun.place: 8960 E. Ridge Road, Hobart (about 27 miles west)
fun.note: General admission $15.99, all-access $25.99. Pumpkins and other u-pick cost extra.

fun.name: Hesston Ghost Train
fun.when: Saturday and Sunday, Oct. 24 and 25 (its last weekend), noon to 5 p.m.
fun.place: Hesston Steam Museum, 1201 E. 1000 N., La Porte
fun.note: A steam train ride through haunted woods; the museum says it's suitable for children. Adults $11, kids 13 and under $7. Free parking.

fun.name: Niles Scream Park
fun.when: Fridays and Saturdays 7 to 11 p.m., Sundays 7 to 10 p.m., through Nov. 1, then "Black Out" nights Nov. 6 and 7, 7 to 10 p.m. These are Eastern times, an hour ahead of La Porte.
fun.place: 855 Mayflower Rd., Niles, Mich. (about 28 miles northeast)
fun.note: Intense. Friday, Oct. 30 is adults only (18 and up, with ID). Packages $33 to $49 online, more at the gate.
